Round 292 (FIX-PD-1c, the narrow-window state for `/studio-lab`) is implemented and ready for C. There is no STOP, nothing was committed, and the report is `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-292.md`. **What changed (exactly the 9 granted paths):** - **New hook** `useStudioWideViewport.ts`: decides narrow or wide at 900 px, and a second hook tells the route when hydration is finished. - **New component** `StudioNarrowScreen.tsx`: the `← CZABA` link, the heading "The Studio works on a computer", the native Middle East preview player, and Send link (share, else copy, else a selectable link field). - **Route** `studio-lab.tsx`: - A phone that never had a wide window gets only the narrow page; the workspace provider is not kept mounted after hydration. - A desktop window that narrows keeps the provider, so clips, mix and Undo survive. The workspace and its key listeners go away, playback stops, and focus moves to the heading. Widening again puts focus back on the `← CZABA` exit. - **Tests:** the theme test changes only the TH4/TH10 lines B allowed, the LRS4 describe now has a 15 000 ms timeout, and two export lines plus doc 218 are added. **Checks run:** - Claims matched the baseline before editing. Afterwards the frozen list fails only on the 5 granted files. - `npm run typecheck` and `npm run lint` pass, and Biome on the changed files passes with no new ignore. - The covering set passes: 8 files, 145 tests. The slowest run was 48 % of its timeout (NG5 at 2403 ms of 5000), so the new test file now declares 15 000 ms. - All 9 named mutants were run and each turns at least one test red. - My own Playwright checks on :5173: - **Direct load:** at 390 and 899 the narrow page shows with no autofocus and no horizontal scroll; at 900 and 1440 the workspace shows. There are no hydration warnings in the browser. - **Desktop pixels:** 0 differing pixels against B's HEAD screenshots at 1280 and 1440. - **JavaScript disabled:** 899 shows only the narrow page and 900 only the workspace. - **Resize from 1440 and 1280:** the clip, the mute and Undo all survive, and playback stops. **The code-reviewer subagent** found two Medium issues. I fixed both: - No test covered stopping playback when the window narrows. I added one (NG5b) that plays a real clip. - Doc 218 understated what a phone does during hydration; it is now corrected. I also fixed three of its Lows: Send link retries now refocus the link field, a later successful share clears that field, and the NG9/NG9c tests unmount their hydrated roots. **Deviations B needs to rule on:** 1. **Status line:** the task said `

`, but Biome rejects that and suggests ``. I used ``, which is still a status region and is what the workspace footer already uses, so no ignore was needed. 2. **Server-snapshot mutant:** it doesn't turn NG3 red, because the task's own table renders the wide tree during SSR either way. I added NG9c (a desktop hydration must not move focus), which does go red. 3. **Claims:** K14 now also lists the new test file, because it renders the route on the server. That change is expected but not in §6's list. 4. **jsdom-only warning:** NG9 allows one jsdom warning about the video's `muted` property. It is not a real-browser warning: Chromium showed none. **Known gaps, not fixed (outside the spec):** - **Library preview:** narrowing during a library preview probably leaves it playing, because nothing stops it when the workspace unmounts. That comes from reading the code; I did not check it in the browser. The fix is one extra call in the route, but the task allows stopping only through `togglePlayback`. - **Phone load cost:** a phone still downloads both demo mp3s and starts the sound synthesis while the page hydrates, same as before. Fixing that needs the frozen context file. - **Preview restart:** after a phone finishes hydrating, the preview player is replaced once. Someone who pressed Play before hydration finished will hear it stop. - **Code-reviewer architecture note:** keep the gate in the route for now. It proposes one later task to delay loading audio until a wide window is confirmed. **Next for C:** all §6 browser rows still belong to C. In particular: the master-tap silence check when narrowing, the audio's extra Tab stops (Chromium's native controls take 6), the JS-disabled boundary (measure the wrapper, not its child's display value), B-JOURNEY-292, the network counts (I saw 3 media requests at every width) and G292-AUTH. The whole backlog is not complete; F8 is ready for verification, not done.
